prompt: What preparation I need to do to hike grand canyon rim-to-rim
response: Hiking rim-to-rim across the Grand Canyon is a challenging but rewarding experience. You should prepare by hiking at least 10-12 miles in a single day to build endurance. It's also important to carry plenty of water and snacks, as there are no services along the way. Wear sturdy shoes and protective clothing to prevent injury and sun exposure. Make sure to check weather conditions and plan your route accordingly.
